endpoint: POST /api/respond (+ restart; 关于你.md read from the data folder)
setup: Every case starts from its own empty data folder (LITTLEBUDDY_DATA_DIR = a new temp dir, absent profile.json = memory on, A40/REQ-036), real Bonsai, Wi-Fi off. 'say' = the lines are sent in one chat as the page sends them (POST /api/respond {line, history}, history = the earlier lines and replies of that chat). 'wait' = 30 s after the last reply, no line sent in that time (chat quiet, A32; 01 §1). 'restart' = stop the server, npm start again, new chat (history []).
